solutionSql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments AS s WHERE s.customer_id = c.id AND s.status = 'delivered') ORDER BY c.id;

rules.howSolved: NOT EXISTS anti-join: a customer is kept when no shipment of theirs has status 'delivered', so customers with no shipments at all are kept.
The status test reads shipments.status only; shipment_events is not referenced.

ambiguities: The ticket writes the status with curly quotes (‘delivered’). I read it as the literal text delivered, with no other casing or spacing.
notes: Read-only item. Ran without error on sample, nulls and empty. Solve time is an estimate.
